domain_restrictions: n is such that the interval 0 <= m <= n-2 contains integers (implicitly requires n >= 2)
m/n is defined (implicitly requires n not equal to 0; typically n >= 2 if n is an integer parameter)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For the fixed parameter n, for every integer m satisfying 0 <= m <= n-2, the inequality F_n(m divided by n) is strictly less than H_n minus 1.

variables.name: n
variables.role: external parameter indexing the functions/constants F_n and H_n

variables.name: m
variables.role: universal quantified input variable ranging over the specified interval

witness_dependencies: none (the statement is purely universal in m)

statement_nl: For every integer m with 0 <= m <= n-2, F_n(m/n) < H_n - 1.
